evidence: VAREVANT production had a dedicated HVAC page but no dedicated Roofing page at run start.
Fresh commercial-intent search surfaced dedicated roofing AI automation competitors including PardisNet and Madifyx.
Competitor pages emphasize roofing-specific missed-call response, lead qualification, CRM integration, booking and estimate follow-up.
